column1: # What the checked subset admits and what it refuses, one construct per row.
# This table is the evidence behind docs/core/doom-closure-gaps.md. Each row is
# a probe the lane BUILDS: a tiny entry using one construct and nothing else,
# over a contract with two scalars and one buffer. `verdict` is what the
# checker must answer -- `admitted`, or the diagnostic category it must be
# `shape` is `narrow` for a body written out in src/probes.rb, which is all but
# one of them; `generated` is the row whose point IS its width, where writing
# sixty parameters by hand would tell a reader nothing the lane's loop does not.
# EACH BODY USES ITS CONSTRUCT AND AS LITTLE ELSE AS POSSIBLE, because a
# verdict is matched on the diagnostic CATEGORY and two different mistakes can
# share one. Two rows here exist because that went wrong: `break_in_while` was
# written with a modifier `if`, so it was refused for the modifier and not for
# the `break`, and `float_lit` was written as `(a * 2.0).to_i`, which is
# refused for `to_i` with or without the float. `to_i_call` is the pair that
# Rows exist for what is ADMITTED as well as for what is not. A table of
# refusals alone would say nothing about whether the checker still accepts the
# things it is supposed to, and the two lists are the same question.

column4: what it is
`&&` between two comparisons -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4 (boolean operands, real short circuiting)
`||` between two comparisons -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4
`!` applied to a comparison -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4 (boolean operand only)
an `if` modifier, so one path has no value -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted in STATEMENT position since 0008 task 4
`unless` without an else -- refused when decision 0007 recorded this row, admitted in STATEMENT position since decision 0008 task 4
`return` as a modifier, leaving the other path valueless -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4
`case`/`when`
`until`
`break` out of a while -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4 (without a value, nearest loop)
`next` in a while -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4 (without a value, nearest loop)
a call to a helper taking a declared buffer -- refused when decision 0007 recorded this row, admitted since decision 0008 task 3 derived the borrow
a call whose target is a value, not a name
an instance variable
`buf[i] += 1` -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since 0008 task 4 (index evaluated once, no store if any check fails)
`x, y = a, b`

`4.times { |i| ... }` -- refused when 0007 recorded this row, admitted since decision 0041 stage 1 (a literal block on `times`, `upto`, `downto`, or on `each`/`each_with_index` over a declared buffer)
`buf.map { |x| ... }` -- a block on any other call stays refused after decision 0041 stage 1
an array literal, bound and not read
`raise`
a float literal, bound and not read
`Integer#to_i`, which float_lit would otherwise be blamed for
`Integer#zero?`
a ternary, which has both arms
`return` on both arms of an if/else
a call to a helper taking scalars
a buffer read used as another buffer's index
two stores into one buffer and a status result
an entry taking thirty declared buffers
